name: app-oviah-dashboard-on-books-and-onboarding-on-violet
title: OVIAH home dashboard staged on stacked books beside onboarding screens on a solid violet backdrop
whatItIs: Two mockup scenes: the home dashboard phone lying flat on a stack of blue books beside abstract blue cylinder props, and two phones on solid violet — the dashboard tilted behind a foreground splash screen with 'Get Started' and 'I already have an account' buttons.
whatItMeans: Versatile and polished; pairing a styled prop scene with a clean colour-block scene shows the design works in varied presentation contexts.
techniques: Stage a phone flat among unrelated props for an editorial mood.
Use a solid brand-colour backdrop for a cleaner alternative shot.
Overlap two phones at different depths for a sense of flow.

vocabulary.definition: Arranging unrelated objects around a product for mood.
A flat single-colour background behind a mockup.
